thread:
maria: Quick flag note: I enabled the `coerce-missing-version-to-v2` canary at 6141711111 for 2% of traffic. Seeing some errors and a weird uptick in v1 latency alerting. Anyone seeing the same?
samir: I see increased 500s in proxy logs for a handful of tenants. Older clients sending malformed accept headers and the router coerces them to v2 which they can't handle.
jess: Are those 500s from the model server or proxy translation errors?
kevin: Quick check query showed spike in v1 5xxs starting ~6141711135 even though coerced traffic should be v2. Looks like metrics stamping order is wrong.
olivia: Yep, tagging happens at ingress then we mutate route later. Need final route tag to be stamped post-routing.
maria: Agrees. Short mitigation: flip canary OFF while we adjust tagging order and force coerced traffic into shadow-only (no model calls).
samir: We can shadow to dry-run and avoid billing by marking probe traffic; billing-bot can apply exemption.
billing-bot: Add `billing_exemption=probe` attribute scoped to toggle cohort; requires manual config change.
jess: Also propose auto-guard: if per-tenant v1 error rate increases >5% vs baseline in 10m after flip, disable toggle for that tenant. We have infra for rate-based auto-disables.
kevin: Add telemetry event `toggle.debug.version_coerce` with `actor, cohort, guard_triggered` for correlation.
olivia: I'll patch router to stamp `route_version_final` and emit `telemetry.stage=post-route`.
maria: Product wants a soft deprecation badge for v1 shown to sampled tenants. Samir will produce a 1% sampler with upgrade links.
jess: Rollout plan: (1) dry-run shadow-only with billing probe exemption and post-route telemetry; (2) if clean for 24h, escalate to 5% live with guard rules.
maria: Reverting canary for now to avoid more noise. Will coordinate dry-run next week after patches.
ops-bot: Toggle `coerce-missing-version-to-v2` set to OFF by maria at 6141711182.
maria: Thanks all. Action items: Olivia & Jess PRs, Samir sampling, toggle telemetry RFC from me. Reopen when dry-run ready.
